## Petualangan Melintasi Batas Pengetahuan: Kisah GPT-4

Di sebuah kelas futuristik yang dipenuhi cahaya holografik, duduklah sekelompok siswa SMA yang sedang mendengarkan penjelasan Bu Rina, guru AI mereka. Hari ini, topik mereka adalah sesuatu yang sedang hangat dibicarakan di dunia teknologi: GPT-4.

"Anak-anak," Bu Rina memulai dengan senyum, "kita akan menyelami salah satu inovasi paling menarik di dunia kecerdasan buatan. Mungkin kalian sudah familiar dengan ChatGPT, kan?"

Siswa-siswa mengangguk. Beberapa bahkan mengangkat tangan, ingin berbagi pengalaman mereka menggunakan ChatGPT untuk tugas sekolah atau sekadar bersenang-senang.

"Nah, bayangkan ChatGPT itu seperti mobil sport yang cepat dan cerdas," lanjut Bu Rina. "Sekarang, bayangkan ada versi terbarunya, yang jauh lebih kuat, lebih pintar, dan bisa melakukan hal-hal yang sebelumnya tidak kita duga. Itulah GPT-4!"

"Kapan GPT-4 dirilis, Bu?" tanya Rio, seorang siswa yang selalu ingin tahu.

Bu Rina menekan tombol pada papan tulis holografiknya, dan sebuah tanggal besar muncul: **14 Maret 2023**.

"Tepat pada tanggal 14 Maret 2023, OpenAI, perusahaan di balik semua ini, meluncurkan GPT-4. Awalnya, ia tersedia dalam bentuk terbatas melalui ChatGPT Plus, versi premium dari ChatGPT yang kalian kenal, dan juga melalui API untuk para pengembang yang mendaftar di daftar tunggu. Ini seperti peluncuran roket baru; tidak semua orang bisa langsung menaikinya, tapi dampaknya terasa ke seluruh dunia."

"Jadi, apa bedanya dengan versi sebelumnya, Bu?" tanya Sarah, yang lebih tertarik pada kemampuan praktisnya. "Apakah hanya lebih cepat?"

"Itu pertanyaan bagus, Sarah!" kata Bu Rina. "Perbedaannya sangat signifikan. Ingat, GPT-4 adalah penerus dari model-model sebelumnya: GPT-1 di tahun 2018, GPT-2 di tahun 2019, dan GPT-3 di tahun 2020, yang kemudian disempurnakan menjadi GPT-3.5 yang menjadi dasar ChatGPT. Setiap versi adalah lompatan besar, dan GPT-4 ini adalah lompatan yang sangat besar."

Bu Rina menampilkan beberapa poin penting tentang kemampuan GPT-4:

### Kemampuan Luar Biasa GPT-4:

1.  **Lebih Andal, Kreatif, dan Paham Instruksi Rumit:**
    "OpenAI sendiri mengatakan bahwa GPT-4 'lebih andal, kreatif, dan mampu menangani instruksi yang jauh lebih bernuansa daripada GPT-3.5'. Bayangkan kalian memberi instruksi pada asisten AI kalian, dan dia tidak hanya memahaminya dengan baik, tapi juga bisa memberikan hasil yang lebih imajinatif dan sesuai konteks yang sangat spesifik."

2.  **Jendela Konteks yang Jauh Lebih Besar:**
    "Salah satu peningkatan paling penting adalah 'jendela konteks'-nya. Ini seperti memori jangka pendek model tersebut. GPT-3.5 hanya bisa mengingat sekitar 4.096 'token' (kata atau bagian kata). GPT-4 punya dua versi, dengan jendela konteks 8.192 atau bahkan 32.768 token! Ini berarti dia bisa memproses dan memahami informasi dari teks yang jauh lebih panjang, seperti seluruh bab buku atau dokumen hukum yang rumit, tanpa kehilangan jejak."

3.  **Model Multimodal: Melihat dan Memahami Gambar!**
    "Ini adalah terobosan besar! Berbeda dengan pendahulunya yang hanya bisa menerima teks, GPT-4 adalah model 'multimodal'. Artinya, ia bisa menerima **gambar dan teks sebagai input**. Bayangkan ini: kalian bisa mengunggah meme dan meminta GPT-4 menjelaskan mengapa meme itu lucu, atau mengunggah tangkapan layar dari grafik dan memintanya meringkas informasi di dalamnya. Bahkan, ia bisa menjawab soal ujian yang berisi diagram!"

    Bu Rina menampilkan contoh di mana GPT-4 berhasil menjelaskan humor dari gambar aneh dan meringkas teks dari screenshot.

4.  **Pesan Sistem untuk Kendali yang Lebih Baik:**
    "OpenAI juga memperkenalkan 'pesan sistem' baru. Ini seperti memberi instruksi awal kepada GPT-4 tentang 'persona' atau 'tugas' apa yang harus diembannya. Misalnya, kalian bisa menyuruhnya, 'Bertindaklah seperti bajak laut Shakespearean,' dan semua jawabannya akan keluar dalam prosa berima ala Shakespeare. Atau, 'Selalu berikan jawabanmu dalam format JSON,' dan dia akan melakukannya. Ini memberi kita kendali yang luar biasa atas bagaimana model itu berinteraksi."

5.  **Berinteraksi dengan Antarmuka Eksternal:**
    "GPT-4 tidak hanya terpaku pada apa yang sudah ada di dalam 'otaknya'. Jika diinstruksikan, ia bisa berinteraksi dengan antarmuka eksternal. Misalnya, kalian bisa memintanya melakukan pencarian web untuk mendapatkan informasi terbaru, dan hasilnya akan dimasukkan ke dalam responsnya. Ini membuka pintu untuk melakukan banyak hal di luar prediksi teks biasa, seperti menggunakan API lain, menghasilkan gambar, atau mengakses dan meringkas halaman web."

6.  **Asisten Coding yang Canggih:**
    "Bagi kalian yang tertarik dengan pemrograman, GPT-4 adalah alat yang luar biasa. Para programmer menemukan bahwa ia sangat membantu dalam tugas coding, seperti menemukan kesalahan dalam kode yang sudah ada atau menyarankan optimasi untuk meningkatkan kinerja. Seorang biofisikawan bahkan mengatakan bahwa waktu yang dibutuhkan untuk memindahkan program dari MATLAB ke Python berkurang dari berhari-hari menjadi 'sekitar satu jam' berkat GPT-4!"

7.  **Lulus Ujian Standar dengan Nilai Tinggi:**
    "GPT-4 menunjukkan kemampuan luar biasa dalam berbagai ujian standar. Dalam pengujian OpenAI sendiri, model ini mendapatkan skor 1410 pada SAT (persentil ke-94), 163 pada LSAT (persentil ke-88), dan 298 pada Ujian Bar Seragam (persentil ke-90). Bandingkan dengan GPT-3.5 yang jauh di bawahnya. Ia bahkan lulus ujian onkologi, teknik, dan bedah plastik!"

8.  **Aplikasi Medis Revolusioner:**
    "Para peneliti dari Microsoft menguji GPT-4 pada masalah medis dan menemukan bahwa tanpa perlu instruksi khusus, ia melampaui nilai kelulusan USMLE (ujian lisensi dokter di AS) dengan lebih dari 20 poin! Ini menunjukkan potensi besar GPT-4 dalam membantu profesional medis, seperti dalam menjawab pertanyaan pasien dan menganalisis rekam medis, seperti yang diumumkan oleh Microsoft dan Epic Systems."

"Wow, itu gila!" seru Dani, ternganga. "Jadi, GPT-4 itu seperti ensiklopedia berjalan yang bisa melihat dan berbicara?"

"Kurang lebih begitu, Dani," Bu Rina tersenyum. "Tapi, penting untuk diingat bahwa ia juga punya keterbatasan."

### Keterbatasan GPT-4:

1.  **Halusinasi:**
    "Seperti pendahulunya, GPT-4 bisa 'berhalusinasi'. Artinya, ia bisa menghasilkan informasi yang tidak ada dalam data pelatihannya atau bahkan bertentangan dengan instruksi kalian. Jadi, jangan langsung percaya semua yang dikatakannya tanpa verifikasi, terutama untuk informasi penting."

2.  **Kurangnya Transparansi:**
    "Kita tidak tahu persis bagaimana ia membuat keputusan. Meskipun ia bisa memberikan penjelasan, penjelasan itu seringkali dibuat 'setelah kejadian' dan tidak selalu mencerminkan proses sebenarnya. Terkadang, penjelasannya bahkan bertentangan dengan pernyataan sebelumnya."

3.  **Bias yang Tersembunyi:**
    "Karena dilatih dengan data dari internet, ia bisa saja memiliki bias yang sama dengan data tersebut. OpenAI sudah berusaha menguranginya dengan 'reinforcement learning from human feedback' untuk menolak permintaan yang berbahaya, tapi beberapa bias kognitif seperti bias konfirmasi masih bisa muncul."

"Jadi, meskipun sangat pintar, kita tetap harus kritis ya, Bu?" tanya Rizal.

"Tepat sekali, Rizal," jawab Bu Rina. "Kecerdasan buatan adalah alat yang sangat kuat, dan seperti semua alat, penggunaannya membutuhkan pemahaman dan tanggung jawab. GPT-4 adalah bukti betapa jauhnya kita telah melangkah dalam AI, tapi juga pengingat bahwa manusia tetap menjadi penentu arah dan pemverifikasi kebenaran."

Siswa-siswa itu tampak terinspirasi. Mereka mulai membayangkan bagaimana teknologi seperti GPT-4 akan mengubah dunia di masa depan, dan bagaimana mereka bisa menjadi bagian dari perubahan itu.

"Ingat," Bu Rina menyimpulkan, "GPT-4 adalah lompatan besar. Ia menunjukkan masa depan di mana AI bisa menjadi kolaborator yang luar biasa dalam berbagai bidang, dari pendidikan hingga kedokteran. Tapi, dengan kekuatan besar datanglah tanggung jawab besar. Mari kita gunakan teknologi ini dengan bijak dan kreatif!"

Dan dengan itu, bel berbunyi, mengakhiri pelajaran tentang GPT-4, namun membuka pintu bagi pemikiran dan imajinasi baru di benak para siswa.

Gaya bahasa yang digunakan sesuai dengan target usia 15-18 tahun, tidak terlalu sederhana namun juga tidak terlalu teknis.

input.question_raw: Question: What caused the gas supply outage in Sheffield, England in December 2022, and how long did the outage last?
input.question: What caused the gas supply outage in Sheffield, England in December 2022, and how long did the outage last?
input.user_message: Buat cerita edukatif yang membantu siswa memahami: What caused the gas supply outage in Sheffield, England in December 2022, and how long did the outage last?
merged_contexts:
The city of Sheffield, England was impacted by a major failure of the local natural gas supply network in December 2022, resulting in a loss of central heating and gas stove availability to more than 3,000 properties in the northwestern suburbs of the city. The outage, which has predominantly affected the Hillsborough, Malin Bridge and Stannington districts, was declared a major incident by Sheffield City Council; some properties were without a gas supply for almost two weeks.
The gas supply outage affected the Cadent Gas network, and was caused by a burst water main on the Yorkshire Water network which resulted in more than 2 million litres of water flooding into the gas supply network. Yorkshire Water confirmed that the breach to the water main had been resolved by 6 December. In addition to the widespread gas supply outage, numerous properties in the affected areas have also suffered from outages to their water and electricity supplies as knock-on effects.Heavy rainfall initially hampered recovery work, followed by cold temperatures and snowfall. In response to the widespread lack of heating availability and increasingly cold temperatures, dropping as low as −3 °C (27 °F) on 9 December, a major incident was declared by local authorities. The Red Cross distributed aid, including food, drinks and blankets, to residents in the affected area.

Timeline
During the evening of 2 December, a water main on Bankfield Lane at the western end of Stannington burst, resulting in flooding in the local area. The affected water main was an asbestos-cement mainline pipe installed in 1970. More than 2 million litres of water, roughly equivalent to three Olympic-sized swimming pools, entered the gas mains in this area and subsequently flowed through pipes down hillsides throughout the Stannington and Hillsborough areas.Property damage was reported in dozens of homes across the affected area, including on High Matlock Road, as water overflowed out of gas meters and gas stoves inside homes; water also overflowed out of manhole covers and the bases of street lights in outdoor areas. Emergency services attended the incident from around midnight, going from door to door to wake residents. Cadent Gas, who operate the natural gas network in the area, described the incident as "unpredecented" and something which they had never had to deal with before.By 3 December more than 1,000 properties were without a gas supply; in addition, many properties in the immediate area of the burst water main also suffered from reduced water supplies, or no water at all, for several days. Engineers from Cadent Gas initially had to go from door to door and turn off the gas supply at each individual affected property, before engineers could commence work to drain and repair the gas network; more than 100 engineers were drafted in to work 24 hours a day to resolve the outage, later rising to more than 200 as the incident progressed.The number of properties affected by the gas supply outage rose to more than 2,000 by 6 December, increasingly affecting homes lower down the hillside in the Hillsborough area of Sheffield. Local electricity network operator Northern Powergrid warned local residents to only use portable electric heaters in occupied rooms and only while residents were at home, in order to reduce strain on the local power supply caused by increased usage of electric heating. Despite this however, residents on some streets in Stannington began to report intermittent power outages throughout the day. Electric car owners were advised to use public charging points rather than those at their own homes.The local authority, Sheffield City Council, officially declared a major incident on 7 December, with thousands of properties still without a gas supply and temperatures forecast to drop below freezing for prolonged periods in the coming days. Only around a quarter of affected properties had had their gas supplies reconnected at the time that the major incident was declared, according to Cadent Gas, as their engineers were struggling to pump the large quantities of water out of the complex local gas network; engineers and equipment were shipped in from across the country to assist in draining the network.According to Cadent Gas, around three-quarters of affected properties had been reconnected to the gas network by 10 December. Considerable difficulties remained in draining water from the gas network in the Hillsborough and Malin Bridge areas, where hundreds of homes still remained without gas.

Response
Refuge spaces were opened officially by the local authorities and unofficially by local businesses, providing warm spaces, hot food and drinks to affected residents. The primary official refuge was opened at Lomas Hall, a church hall on Church Street in Stannington, where residents were issued with portable electric heaters and electric hotplates for cooking. The Peacock Inn pub on Stannington Road opened to provide residents with food and hot drinks, while the nearby Crown & Glove pub on Uppergate Road opened to provide showering facilities.Schools in the affected areas remained open, despite the interruption to their gas supplies; individual classrooms were heated using portable electric heaters, and Nook Lane Junior School advised parents to send children to school wearing additional warm clothing and with a packed lunch due to the unavailability of their kitchen facilities.The Liberal Democrat councillor for the Stannington ward, Penny Baker, praised local residents for showing resilience and "community spirit" by coming together in the face of the crisis. Terry Fox, the leader of Sheffield City Council, declared a major incident on 7 December, stating that it would allow the local authorities to "better co-ordinate the overall response" to the crisis.Olivia Blake, the Labour Member of Parliament for the Sheffield Hallam constituency in which Stannington is located, raised the gas supply outage during a debate in the House of Commons on 7 December, asking for direct government assistance and emergency funding.

Aftermath
Yorkshire Water issued an apology to affected customers on 6 December, stating that they "understood how difficult it was" for affected residents. Musim dingin Desember 2022 di Sheffield, Inggris, seharusnya menjadi waktu yang nyaman, penuh dengan kehangatan perapian dan makanan hangat. Namun, bagi ribuan keluarga di pinggiran barat laut kota, terutama di Hillsborough, Malin Bridge, dan Stannington, kenyamanan itu tiba-tiba lenyap. Pemanas sentral mereka mati, kompor gas mereka tidak berfungsi. Mereka terjebak dalam cuaca dingin, dan penyebabnya adalah sebuah insiden yang luar biasa.

**Apa yang Terjadi? Titik Awal Kekacauan**

Bayangkan sebuah pipa air, yang tersembunyi di bawah tanah, diam-diam membawa air ke rumah-rumah. Sekarang, bayangkan pipa itu tiba-tiba pecah. Itulah yang terjadi pada malam tanggal 2 Desember 2022, di Bankfield Lane, Stannington. Sebuah pipa utama air yang sudah tua, dipasang pada tahun 1970, pecah. Tapi ini bukan sekadar kebocoran kecil.

**Penyebab Utama: Banjir yang Tak Terduga**

Pipa air yang pecah ini melepaskan lebih dari 2 juta liter air—setara dengan sekitar tiga kolam renang ukuran Olimpiade! Dan inilah bagian yang paling mengerikan: air sebanyak itu tidak hanya membanjiri jalanan. Entah bagaimana, air itu menyusup ke dalam jaringan pipa gas alam di area tersebut.

Bayangkan pipa gas Anda, yang seharusnya hanya berisi gas, tiba-tiba dipenuhi air. Ini seperti mengisi mesin mobil dengan air alih-alih bensin—tidak akan berfungsi, dan justru bisa menyebabkan kerusakan serius.

**Dampak Langsung: Kekacauan di Rumah dan Jalanan**

Dalam semalam, air mulai mengalir melalui pipa gas, menuruni lereng bukit, memasuki rumah-rumah di Stannington dan Hillsborough. Warga melaporkan air meluap dari meteran gas dan kompor gas di dalam rumah mereka. Di luar, air memancar dari penutup lubang got dan dasar lampu jalan. Ini adalah pemandangan yang aneh dan mengkhawatirkan.

Petugas layanan darurat segera datang, mengetuk pintu warga di tengah malam untuk membangunkan mereka dan memperingatkan tentang bahaya. Dalam cuaca dingin Desember, ini adalah masalah serius. Jumlah ini terus meningkat menjadi lebih dari 2.000 properti pada 6 Desember, terutama di daerah yang lebih rendah di Hillsborough.
2.  **Dampak Berantai:** Selain gas, beberapa properti juga kehilangan pasokan air dan listrik sebagai efek domino. Peningkatan penggunaan pemanas listrik portabel membebani jaringan listrik lokal, menyebabkan pemadaman listrik sesekali.
3.  **Kondisi Cuaca Ekstrem:** Hujan deras menghambat pekerjaan pemulihan di awal, diikuti oleh suhu dingin yang ekstrem dan bahkan salju. Suhu turun hingga -3 °C, membuat situasi semakin genting bagi warga tanpa pemanas.

Pemadaman gas ini bukan masalah yang bisa diselesaikan dalam semalam. Cadent Gas harus mengerahkan ratusan insinyur, bekerja 24 jam sehari, 7 hari seminggu. Tugas mereka adalah:
*   Mematikan pasokan gas satu per satu di setiap properti yang terkena dampak.
*   Memompa keluar jutaan liter air dari jaringan pipa gas yang kompleks.
*   Memastikan pipa gas benar-benar kering dan aman sebelum pasokan gas bisa dinyalakan kembali.

Meskipun Yorkshire Water berhasil memperbaiki pipa air yang pecah pada tanggal 6 Desember, pekerjaan untuk memulihkan pasokan gas jauh lebih rumit.

input.user_input: Pembuatan cerita dari teks berikut: Buat cerita edukatif yang membantu siswa memahami: What caused the gas supply outage in Sheffield, England in December 2022, and how long did the outage last?
contexts:
The city of Sheffield, England was impacted by a major failure of the local natural gas supply network in December 2022, resulting in a loss of central heating and gas stove availability to more than 3,000 properties in the northwestern suburbs of the city. The outage, which has predominantly affected the Hillsborough, Malin Bridge and Stannington districts, was declared a major incident by Sheffield City Council; some properties were without a gas supply for almost two weeks.
The gas supply outage affected the Cadent Gas network, and was caused by a burst water main on the Yorkshire Water network which resulted in more than 2 million litres of water flooding into the gas supply network. Yorkshire Water confirmed that the breach to the water main had been resolved by 6 December. In addition to the widespread gas supply outage, numerous properties in the affected areas have also suffered from outages to their water and electricity supplies as knock-on effects.Heavy rainfall initially hampered recovery work, followed by cold temperatures and snowfall. In response to the widespread lack of heating availability and increasingly cold temperatures, dropping as low as −3 °C (27 °F) on 9 December, a major incident was declared by local authorities. The Red Cross distributed aid, including food, drinks and blankets, to residents in the affected area.

Timeline
During the evening of 2 December, a water main on Bankfield Lane at the western end of Stannington burst, resulting in flooding in the local area. The affected water main was an asbestos-cement mainline pipe installed in 1970. More than 2 million litres of water, roughly equivalent to three Olympic-sized swimming pools, entered the gas mains in this area and subsequently flowed through pipes down hillsides throughout the Stannington and Hillsborough areas.Property damage was reported in dozens of homes across the affected area, including on High Matlock Road, as water overflowed out of gas meters and gas stoves inside homes; water also overflowed out of manhole covers and the bases of street lights in outdoor areas. Emergency services attended the incident from around midnight, going from door to door to wake residents. Cadent Gas, who operate the natural gas network in the area, described the incident as "unpredecented" and something which they had never had to deal with before.By 3 December more than 1,000 properties were without a gas supply; in addition, many properties in the immediate area of the burst water main also suffered from reduced water supplies, or no water at all, for several days. Engineers from Cadent Gas initially had to go from door to door and turn off the gas supply at each individual affected property, before engineers could commence work to drain and repair the gas network; more than 100 engineers were drafted in to work 24 hours a day to resolve the outage, later rising to more than 200 as the incident progressed.The number of properties affected by the gas supply outage rose to more than 2,000 by 6 December, increasingly affecting homes lower down the hillside in the Hillsborough area of Sheffield. Local electricity network operator Northern Powergrid warned local residents to only use portable electric heaters in occupied rooms and only while residents were at home, in order to reduce strain on the local power supply caused by increased usage of electric heating. Despite this however, residents on some streets in Stannington began to report intermittent power outages throughout the day. Electric car owners were advised to use public charging points rather than those at their own homes.The local authority, Sheffield City Council, officially declared a major incident on 7 December, with thousands of properties still without a gas supply and temperatures forecast to drop below freezing for prolonged periods in the coming days. Only around a quarter of affected properties had had their gas supplies reconnected at the time that the major incident was declared, according to Cadent Gas, as their engineers were struggling to pump the large quantities of water out of the complex local gas network; engineers and equipment were shipped in from across the country to assist in draining the network.According to Cadent Gas, around three-quarters of affected properties had been reconnected to the gas network by 10 December. Considerable difficulties remained in draining water from the gas network in the Hillsborough and Malin Bridge areas, where hundreds of homes still remained without gas.

Response
Refuge spaces were opened officially by the local authorities and unofficially by local businesses, providing warm spaces, hot food and drinks to affected residents. The primary official refuge was opened at Lomas Hall, a church hall on Church Street in Stannington, where residents were issued with portable electric heaters and electric hotplates for cooking. The Peacock Inn pub on Stannington Road opened to provide residents with food and hot drinks, while the nearby Crown & Glove pub on Uppergate Road opened to provide showering facilities.Schools in the affected areas remained open, despite the interruption to their gas supplies; individual classrooms were heated using portable electric heaters, and Nook Lane Junior School advised parents to send children to school wearing additional warm clothing and with a packed lunch due to the unavailability of their kitchen facilities.The Liberal Democrat councillor for the Stannington ward, Penny Baker, praised local residents for showing resilience and "community spirit" by coming together in the face of the crisis. Terry Fox, the leader of Sheffield City Council, declared a major incident on 7 December, stating that it would allow the local authorities to "better co-ordinate the overall response" to the crisis.Olivia Blake, the Labour Member of Parliament for the Sheffield Hallam constituency in which Stannington is located, raised the gas supply outage during a debate in the House of Commons on 7 December, asking for direct government assistance and emergency funding.

Yorkshire Water issued an apology to affected customers on 6 December, stating that they "understood how difficult it was" for affected residents. The water company was criticised for their part in causing the crisis, although a spokesperson maintained that the affected water main had previously been in a good condition and had not suffered any problems in more than a decade. Cadent Gas initially announced that residents would be compensated for any extra electricity usage caused by increased usage of portable electric heaters and other devices, before confirming that affected residents would receive double the usual rate of compensation for a gas outage, totalling £910 for a seven-day outage (or £1,470 for a commercial property).Angry local residents interrupted a news conference being held by Yorkshire Water director Neil Dewis in Stannington on 9 December, heckling him and accusing the company of not taking the situation seriously. Residents claimed that there had been up to ten recent burst water mains in the Stannington area prior to the major incident, accusing Yorkshire Water of providing inadequate maintenance. ## Kisah Pemadaman Gas Sheffield: Ketika Air Bertemu Api (Dan Mengapa Itu Buruk)

Musim dingin Desember 2022 di Sheffield, Inggris, seharusnya menjadi waktu yang nyaman, penuh dengan kehangatan perapian dan makanan hangat. Namun, bagi ribuan keluarga di pinggiran barat laut kota, terutama di Hillsborough, Malin Bridge, dan Stannington, kenyamanan itu tiba-tiba lenyap. Pemanas sentral mereka mati, kompor gas mereka tidak berfungsi. Mereka terjebak dalam cuaca dingin, dan penyebabnya adalah sebuah insiden yang luar biasa.

**Apa yang Terjadi? Titik Awal Kekacauan**

Bayangkan sebuah pipa air, yang tersembunyi di bawah tanah, diam-diam membawa air ke rumah-rumah. Sekarang, bayangkan pipa itu tiba-tiba pecah. Itulah yang terjadi pada malam tanggal 2 Desember 2022, di Bankfield Lane, Stannington. Sebuah pipa utama air yang sudah tua, dipasang pada tahun 1970, pecah. Tapi ini bukan sekadar kebocoran kecil.

**Penyebab Utama: Banjir yang Tak Terduga**

Pipa air yang pecah ini melepaskan lebih dari 2 juta liter air—setara dengan sekitar tiga kolam renang ukuran Olimpiade! Dan inilah bagian yang paling mengerikan: air sebanyak itu tidak hanya membanjiri jalanan. Entah bagaimana, air itu menyusup ke dalam jaringan pipa gas alam di area tersebut.

Bayangkan pipa gas Anda, yang seharusnya hanya berisi gas, tiba-tiba dipenuhi air. Ini seperti mengisi mesin mobil dengan air alih-alih bensin—tidak akan berfungsi, dan justru bisa menyebabkan kerusakan serius.

**Dampak Langsung: Kekacauan di Rumah dan Jalanan**

Dalam semalam, air mulai mengalir melalui pipa gas, menuruni lereng bukit, memasuki rumah-rumah di Stannington dan Hillsborough. Warga melaporkan air meluap dari meteran gas dan kompor gas di dalam rumah mereka. Di luar, air memancar dari penutup lubang got dan dasar lampu jalan. Petugas layanan darurat segera datang, mengetuk pintu warga di tengah malam untuk membangunkan mereka dan memperingatkan tentang bahaya. 2.  **Dampak Berantai:** Selain gas, beberapa properti juga kehilangan pasokan air dan listrik sebagai efek domino. Peningkatan penggunaan pemanas listrik portabel membebani jaringan listrik lokal, menyebabkan pemadaman listrik sesekali.
3.  **Kondisi Cuaca Ekstrem:** Hujan deras menghambat pekerjaan pemulihan di awal, diikuti oleh suhu dingin yang ekstrem dan bahkan salju. Suhu turun hingga -3 °C, membuat situasi semakin genting bagi warga tanpa pemanas.

**Berapa Lama Pemadaman Berlangsung?**

Pemadaman gas ini bukan masalah yang bisa diselesaikan dalam semalam. Cadent Gas harus mengerahkan ratusan insinyur, bekerja 24 jam sehari, 7 hari seminggu. Tugas mereka adalah:
*   Mematikan pasokan gas satu per satu di setiap properti yang terkena dampak.
*   Memompa keluar jutaan liter air dari jaringan pipa gas yang kompleks.
*   Memastikan pipa gas benar-benar kering dan aman sebelum pasokan gas bisa dinyalakan kembali.

Meskipun Yorkshire Water berhasil memperbaiki pipa air yang pecah pada tanggal 6 Desember, pekerjaan untuk memulihkan pasokan gas jauh lebih rumit.

Pada tanggal 7 Desember, Dewan Kota Sheffield secara resmi menyatakan "insiden besar" karena ribuan properti masih tanpa gas dan perkiraan cuaca yang semakin dingin. Butuh waktu hampir dua minggu bagi beberapa properti untuk mendapatkan kembali pasokan gas mereka.

Pada tanggal 10 Desember, sekitar tiga perempat properti telah terhubung kembali, tetapi ratusan rumah di Hillsborough dan Malin Bridge masih berjuang tanpa gas. Ini menunjukkan betapa sulitnya membersihkan air dari jaringan yang rumit.

**Respon Komunitas dan Kritik**

Meskipun situasinya sulit, semangat komunitas di Sheffield bersinar. Tempat-tempat penampungan dibuka, menyediakan tempat hangat, makanan, dan minuman panas. Pub lokal bahkan menawarkan fasilitas mandi.

*   **Infrastruktur yang Terhubung:** Menunjukkan bagaimana kegagalan di satu sistem infrastruktur (pipa air) dapat memiliki dampak besar dan tak terduga pada sistem lain (jaringan gas).
*   **Pentingnya Pemeliharaan:** Menyoroti pentingnya pemeliharaan infrastruktur yang tepat untuk mencegah insiden semacam ini.
*   **Ketahanan Komunitas:** Menunjukkan kekuatan dan ketahanan komunitas dalam menghadapi krisis, serta pentingnya respons yang cepat dan terkoordinasi dari pihak berwenang dan perusahaan layanan.

Jadi, pemadaman gas di Sheffield pada Desember 2022 disebabkan oleh **pecahnya pipa utama air yang membanjiri jaringan pipa gas dengan lebih dari 2 juta liter air.** Pemadaman ini **berlangsung selama hampir dua minggu** bagi beberapa properti, menciptakan tantangan besar bagi ribuan warga di tengah musim dingin. - **instruction_alignment_score** (1–5): skor untuk "Keselarasan Instruksi, QA, dan Aksesibilitas"
- **score** (1.0–5.0): rata-rata dari kelima skor dimensi di atas
- **gap_analysis**: `"Sufficient"` jika riset cukup, `"Missing Info"` jika perlu riset tambahan
- **decision**: `"APPROVE"` / `"REVISE"` / `"NEED_MORE_RESEARCH"`
- **needs_revision**: `true` jika draf perlu direvisi (saat decision = REVISE atau NEED_MORE_RESEARCH)
- **feedback**: satu paragraf ringkasan umpan balik kritis yang mencakup kekuatan dan kelemahan fatal
- **strengths**: daftar kekuatan cerita (tiap item satu kalimat ringkas)
- **weaknesses**: daftar kelemahan/masalah; gunakan format `ISSUE: [Paragraf N: "kutipan"] → masalah → saran` jika ada lokasi spesifik

The city of Sheffield, England was impacted by a major failure of the local natural gas supply network in December 2022, resulting in a loss of central heating and gas stove availability to more than 3,000 properties in the northwestern suburbs of the city. The outage, which has predominantly affected the Hillsborough, Malin Bridge and Stannington districts, was declared a major incident by Sheffield City Council; some properties were without a gas supply for almost two weeks.
The gas supply outage affected the Cadent Gas network, and was caused by a burst water main on the Yorkshire Water network which resulted in more than 2 million litres of water flooding into the gas supply network. Yorkshire Water confirmed that the breach to the water main had been resolved by 6 December. In addition to the widespread gas supply outage, numerous properties in the affected areas have also suffered from outages to their water and electricity supplies as knock-on effects.Heavy rainfall initially hampered recovery work, followed by cold temperatures and snowfall. In response to the widespread lack of heating availability and increasingly cold temperatures, dropping as low as −3 °C (27 °F) on 9 December, a major incident was declared by local authorities. The Red Cross distributed aid, including food, drinks and blankets, to residents in the affected area.

Timeline
During the evening of 2 December, a water main on Bankfield Lane at the western end of Stannington burst, resulting in flooding in the local area. The affected water main was an asbestos-cement mainline pipe installed in 1970. More than 2 million litres of water, roughly equivalent to three Olympic-sized swimming pools, entered the gas mains in this area and subsequently flowed through pipes down hillsides throughout the Stannington and Hillsborough areas.Property damage was reported in dozens of homes across the affected area, including on High Matlock Road, as water overflowed out of gas meters and gas stoves inside homes; water also overflowed out of manhole covers and the bases of street lights in outdoor areas. Emergency services attended the incident from around midnight, going from door to door to wake residents. Cadent Gas, who operate the natural gas network in the area, described the incident as "unpredecented" and something which they had never had to deal with before.By 3 December more than 1,000 properties were without a gas supply; in addition, many properties in the immediate area of the burst water main also suffered from reduced water supplies, or no water at all, for several days. Engineers from Cadent Gas initially had to go from door to door and turn off the gas supply at each individual affected property, before engineers could commence work to drain and repair the gas network; more than 100 engineers were drafted in to work 24 hours a day to resolve the outage, later rising to more than 200 as the incident progressed.The number of properties affected by the gas supply outage rose to more than 2,000 by 6 December, increasingly affecting homes lower down the hillside in the Hillsborough area of Sheffield. Local electricity network operator Northern Powergrid warned local residents to only use portable electric heaters in occupied rooms and only while residents were at home, in order to reduce strain on the local power supply caused by increased usage of electric heating. Despite this however, residents on some streets in Stannington began to report intermittent power outages throughout the day. Electric car owners were advised to use public charging points rather than those at their own homes.The local authority, Sheffield City Council, officially declared a major incident on 7 December, with thousands of properties still without a gas supply and temperatures forecast to drop below freezing for prolonged periods in the coming days. Only around a quarter of affected properties had had their gas supplies reconnected at the time that the major incident was declared, according to Cadent Gas, as their engineers were struggling to pump the large quantities of water out of the complex local gas network; engineers and equipment were shipped in from across the country to assist in draining the network.According to Cadent Gas, around three-quarters of affected properties had been reconnected to the gas network by 10 December. Considerable difficulties remained in draining water from the gas network in the Hillsborough and Malin Bridge areas, where hundreds of homes still remained without gas.

Response
Refuge spaces were opened officially by the local authorities and unofficially by local businesses, providing warm spaces, hot food and drinks to affected residents. The primary official refuge was opened at Lomas Hall, a church hall on Church Street in Stannington, where residents were issued with portable electric heaters and electric hotplates for cooking. The Peacock Inn pub on Stannington Road opened to provide residents with food and hot drinks, while the nearby Crown & Glove pub on Uppergate Road opened to provide showering facilities.Schools in the affected areas remained open, despite the interruption to their gas supplies; individual classrooms were heated using portable electric heaters, and Nook Lane Junior School advised parents to send children to school wearing additional warm clothing and with a packed lunch due to the unavailability of their kitchen facilities.The Liberal Democrat councillor for the Stannington ward, Penny Baker, praised local residents for showing resilience and "community spirit" by coming together in the face of the crisis. Terry Fox, the leader of Sheffield City Council, declared a major incident on 7 December, stating that it would allow the local authorities to "better co-ordinate the overall response" to the crisis.Olivia Blake, the Labour Member of Parliament for the Sheffield Hallam constituency in which Stannington is located, raised the gas supply outage during a debate in the House of Commons on 7 December, asking for direct government assistance and emergency funding.

Aftermath
Yorkshire Water issued an apology to affected customers on 6 December, stating that they "understood how difficult it was" for affected residents. The water company was criticised for their part in causing the crisis, although a spokesperson maintained that the affected water main had previously been in a good condition and had not suffered any problems in more than a decade. Cadent Gas initially announced that residents would be compensated for any extra electricity usage caused by increased usage of portable electric heaters and other devices, before confirming that affected residents would receive double the usual rate of compensation for a gas outage, totalling £910 for a seven-day outage (or £1,470 for a commercial property).Angry local residents interrupted a news conference being held by Yorkshire Water director Neil Dewis in Stannington on 9 December, heckling him and accusing the company of not taking the situation seriously. Residents claimed that there had been up to ten recent burst water mains in the Stannington area prior to the major incident, accusing Yorkshire Water of providing inadequate maintenance. In contrast, efforts by Cadent Gas and Northern Powergrid to deal with the crisis were praised by local residents.Cadent appointed Aspect Maintenance from London as major contractor to replace hundreds of damaged gas appliances by 45 Engineers working 12 hours each day 7 days a week for 4 months.

---

## Kisah Pemadaman Gas Sheffield: Ketika Air Bertemu Api (Dan Mengapa Itu Buruk)

Musim dingin Desember 2022 di Sheffield, Inggris, seharusnya menjadi waktu yang nyaman, penuh dengan kehangatan perapian dan makanan hangat. Namun, bagi ribuan keluarga di pinggiran barat laut kota, terutama di Hillsborough, Malin Bridge, dan Stannington, kenyamanan itu tiba-tiba lenyap. Pemanas sentral mereka mati, kompor gas mereka tidak berfungsi. Mereka terjebak dalam cuaca dingin, dan penyebabnya adalah sebuah insiden yang luar biasa.

**Apa yang Terjadi? Titik Awal Kekacauan**

Bayangkan sebuah pipa air, yang tersembunyi di bawah tanah, diam-diam membawa air ke rumah-rumah. Sekarang, bayangkan pipa itu tiba-tiba pecah. Itulah yang terjadi pada malam tanggal 2 Desember 2022, di Bankfield Lane, Stannington. Sebuah pipa utama air yang sudah tua, dipasang pada tahun 1970, pecah. Tapi ini bukan sekadar kebocoran kecil.

**Penyebab Utama: Banjir yang Tak Terduga**

Pipa air yang pecah ini melepaskan lebih dari 2 juta liter air—setara dengan sekitar tiga kolam renang ukuran Olimpiade! Dan inilah bagian yang paling mengerikan: air sebanyak itu tidak hanya membanjiri jalanan. Entah bagaimana, air itu menyusup ke dalam jaringan pipa gas alam di area tersebut.

Bayangkan pipa gas Anda, yang seharusnya hanya berisi gas, tiba-tiba dipenuhi air. Ini seperti mengisi mesin mobil dengan air alih-alih bensin—tidak akan berfungsi, dan justru bisa menyebabkan kerusakan serius.

**Dampak Langsung: Kekacauan di Rumah dan Jalanan**

Dalam semalam, air mulai mengalir melalui pipa gas, menuruni lereng bukit, memasuki rumah-rumah di Stannington dan Hillsborough. Warga melaporkan air meluap dari meteran gas dan kompor gas di dalam rumah mereka. Di luar, air memancar dari penutup lubang got dan dasar lampu jalan. Ini adalah pemandangan yang aneh dan mengkhawatirkan.

Petugas layanan darurat segera datang, mengetuk pintu warga di tengah malam untuk membangunkan mereka dan memperingatkan tentang bahaya. Cadent Gas, perusahaan yang mengelola jaringan gas, menyebut insiden ini "belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya." Mereka belum pernah menghadapi situasi seperti ini sebelumnya.

**Mengapa Ini Menjadi Masalah Besar?**

1.  **Kehilangan Pasokan Gas:** Lebih dari 1.000 properti langsung kehilangan pasokan gas mereka. Ini berarti tidak ada pemanas, tidak ada kompor, tidak ada air panas. Dalam cuaca dingin Desember, ini adalah masalah serius. Jumlah ini terus meningkat menjadi lebih dari 2.000 properti pada 6 Desember, terutama di daerah yang lebih rendah di Hillsborough.
2.  **Dampak Berantai:** Selain gas, beberapa properti juga kehilangan pasokan air dan listrik sebagai efek domino. Peningkatan penggunaan pemanas listrik portabel membebani jaringan listrik lokal, menyebabkan pemadaman listrik sesekali.
3.  **Kondisi Cuaca Ekstrem:** Hujan deras menghambat pekerjaan pemulihan di awal, diikuti oleh suhu dingin yang ekstrem dan bahkan salju. Suhu turun hingga -3 °C, membuat situasi semakin genting bagi warga tanpa pemanas.

**Berapa Lama Pemadaman Berlangsung?**

Pemadaman gas ini bukan masalah yang bisa diselesaikan dalam semalam. Cadent Gas harus mengerahkan ratusan insinyur, bekerja 24 jam sehari, 7 hari seminggu. Tugas mereka adalah:
*   Mematikan pasokan gas satu per satu di setiap properti yang terkena dampak.
*   Memompa keluar jutaan liter air dari jaringan pipa gas yang kompleks.
*   Memastikan pipa gas benar-benar kering dan aman sebelum pasokan gas bisa dinyalakan kembali.

Meskipun Yorkshire Water berhasil memperbaiki pipa air yang pecah pada tanggal 6 Desember, pekerjaan untuk memulihkan pasokan gas jauh lebih rumit.

Pada tanggal 7 Desember, Dewan Kota Sheffield secara resmi menyatakan "insiden besar" karena ribuan properti masih tanpa gas dan perkiraan cuaca yang semakin dingin. Butuh waktu hampir dua minggu bagi beberapa properti untuk mendapatkan kembali pasokan gas mereka.

Pada tanggal 10 Desember, sekitar tiga perempat properti telah terhubung kembali, tetapi ratusan rumah di Hillsborough dan Malin Bridge masih berjuang tanpa gas. Ini menunjukkan betapa sulitnya membersihkan air dari jaringan yang rumit.

**Respon Komunitas dan Kritik**

Meskipun situasinya sulit, semangat komunitas di Sheffield bersinar. Tempat-tempat penampungan dibuka, menyediakan tempat hangat, makanan, dan minuman panas. Pub lokal bahkan menawarkan fasilitas mandi.

Namun, ada juga kritik tajam terhadap Yorkshire Water. Warga menuduh perusahaan tersebut tidak melakukan perawatan yang memadai, mengklaim bahwa ada banyak pipa air pecah lainnya di daerah tersebut sebelum insiden besar ini. Yorkshire Water meminta maaf, tetapi tetap mempertahankan bahwa pipa yang pecah itu sebelumnya dalam kondisi baik.

Sebaliknya, Cadent Gas dan Northern Powergrid dipuji atas respons cepat dan kerja keras mereka dalam mengatasi krisis ini. Mereka bahkan mengkompensasi warga atas peningkatan penggunaan listrik dan kerugian akibat pemadaman gas.

**Pelajaran yang Didapat:**

Kisah pemadaman gas di Sheffield ini mengajarkan kita beberapa hal penting:
*   **Infrastruktur yang Terhubung:** Menunjukkan bagaimana kegagalan di satu sistem infrastruktur (pipa air) dapat memiliki dampak besar dan tak terduga pada sistem lain (jaringan gas).
*   **Pentingnya Pemeliharaan:** Menyoroti pentingnya pemeliharaan infrastruktur yang tepat untuk mencegah insiden semacam ini.
*   **Ketahanan Komunitas:** Menunjukkan kekuatan dan ketahanan komunitas dalam menghadapi krisis, serta pentingnya respons yang cepat dan terkoordinasi dari pihak berwenang dan perusahaan layanan.

Jadi, pemadaman gas di Sheffield pada Desember 2022 disebabkan oleh **pecahnya pipa utama air yang membanjiri jaringan pipa gas dengan lebih dari 2 juta liter air.** Pemadaman ini **berlangsung selama hampir dua minggu** bagi beberapa properti, menciptakan tantangan besar bagi ribuan warga di tengah musim dingin. Sebuah pengingat bahwa di balik kenyamanan modern, ada jaringan kompleks yang membutuhkan perhatian dan perawatan konstan.

input.user_input:
## The Unseen Chill: Afghanistan's January 2023 Cold Snap

**Characters:**

*   **Aisha:** A curious and empathetic high school student, interested in global events.
*   **Mr. Khan:** Aisha's history and geography teacher, knowledgeable and patient.
*   **Jamal:** A fictional Afghan teenager, representing those affected by the cold snap.

---

The fluorescent lights of the classroom hummed, a stark contrast to the biting winter winds Aisha could feel even through the thick windowpanes. Mr. Khan stood at the front, a world map projected behind him.

"Good morning, class," he began, his voice calm but with a subtle seriousness. "Today, we're going to step away from our usual curriculum for a moment and look at a recent event that had a profound impact. We're going to talk about the cold snap in Afghanistan in January 2023."

Aisha, usually quick to doodle in her notebook, put her pen down. She’d heard snippets on the news, but the full picture was still hazy.

"Imagine this," Mr. Khan continued, gesturing towards the map, "a country already facing immense challenges, suddenly plunged into an extreme winter. This wasn't just a few chilly days; it was a brutal, sustained cold that began around January 10th."

He clicked to the next slide, revealing an image of snow-covered mountains, beautiful yet ominous.

"Let's start with the raw numbers, which can be difficult to grasp without context. During this cold snap, temperatures in Afghanistan plummeted to an astonishing **-33 degrees Celsius, or -27 degrees Fahrenheit**."

A collective gasp rippled through the classroom. Aisha shivered, thinking of how cold -5°C felt on a school morning.

"To put that in perspective," Mr. Khan explained, "that's colder than the inside of most freezers. It’s a temperature that can cause frostbite in minutes if you’re not adequately protected. And it wasn't just the cold. Many mountainous regions experienced significant snowfall, with some areas receiving as much as **30 centimeters, or 12 inches, of snow**."

He paused, letting the information sink in. "Now, think about what those conditions mean for people. How do you stay warm? How do you travel? How do you find food?"

Aisha raised her hand. "Mr. Khan, how many people were affected by this? It sounds incredibly dangerous."

"An excellent question, Aisha," Mr. Khan nodded. "The human cost was devastating. This cold snap tragically led to the deaths of at least **162 people**. This made it the deadliest weather event of 2023 at the time, only later surpassed by Cyclone Freddy."

He clicked again, showing a graph. "But the impact wasn't just from exposure to the cold. In one province, Herat, at least 140 people were hospitalized due to **carbon monoxide poisoning**. Can anyone guess why?"

Another student, Ben, ventured, "Because they were trying to stay warm indoors, maybe with unsafe heating methods?"

"Exactly, Ben," Mr. Khan confirmed. "When people are desperate to escape such extreme cold, they might use charcoal braziers or improperly ventilated gas heaters, leading to this silent, deadly threat."

Aisha felt a pang of sadness. It wasn't just the cold, but the desperate measures people had to take to survive it.

"And it wasn't just people who suffered," Mr. Khan continued, his voice softening slightly. "Afghanistan is an agrarian society, and livestock are crucial for sustenance and income. During this cold snap, over **77,000 livestock perished**."

Aisha imagined families losing their entire herds, their livelihoods vanishing overnight. "That's a huge number, Mr. Khan. How could they recover from that?"

"It's an immense challenge, Aisha. And to make matters worse, this cold snap hit Afghanistan when the country was already in the grip of a severe famine, affecting more than half its population. Imagine being hungry, then facing these deadly temperatures and losing your animals."

He explained the complex geopolitical situation. "Following the 2021 Taliban offensive, Afghanistan had become somewhat isolated on the global stage. This meant that when this disaster struck, foreign aid was very limited at first. Providing relief was incredibly difficult."

"But people must have tried to help, right?" Aisha asked, hope in her voice.

"Yes, they did. Humanitarian efforts were mobilized, providing things like heating supplies and financial aid. However, there were significant obstacles. For instance, a ban on women working in humanitarian roles complicated efforts. Imagine trying to reach and assist women and children in conservative communities without female aid workers."

He showed an image of aid workers distributing blankets. "Fortunately, these restrictions were somewhat relaxed for health-related aid on January 17th. This allowed crucial organizations like the International Rescue Committee, Save the Children, and Care International to resume some of their vital operations."

"Were they able to reach everyone?" Ben asked.

"Unfortunately, no. Military helicopters were used to deliver aid to some communities cut off by the snow. But even these couldn't access all of Afghanistan's incredibly rugged, mountainous regions. Some people were simply too isolated."

Mr. Khan clicked to the last slide, a simple world map highlighting Afghanistan. "This event in January 2023 serves as a powerful reminder of several things. Firstly, the devastating power of extreme weather, especially when combined with existing vulnerabilities. Secondly, the interconnectedness of global challenges – how political situations can impact humanitarian responses. And finally, the incredible resilience of people facing unimaginable hardship, and the vital role of humanitarian aid in such crises."

Aisha looked down at her notebook, no longer empty. She had scribbled down key figures: -33°C, 30cm snow, 162 lives, 77,000 livestock. But more than the numbers, she now understood the story behind them – a story of an unseen chill that brought immense suffering, but also highlighted the enduring human spirit and the crucial need for global empathy and support.

*   **Jamal:** A fictional Afghan teenager, representing those affected by the cold snap.

---

The fluorescent lights of the classroom hummed, a stark contrast to the biting winter winds Aisha could feel even through the thick windowpanes. Mr. Khan stood at the front, a world map projected behind him.

"Good morning, class," he began, his voice calm but with a subtle seriousness. "Today, we're going to step away from our usual curriculum for a moment and look at a recent event that had a profound impact. We're going to talk about the cold snap in Afghanistan in January 2023."

"Imagine this," Mr. Khan continued, gesturing towards the map, "a country already facing immense challenges, suddenly plunged into an extreme winter. This wasn't just a few chilly days; it was a brutal, sustained cold that began around January 10th."

He clicked to the next slide, revealing an image of snow-covered mountains, beautiful yet ominous.

input.user_input:
## The Unseen Chill: Afghanistan's January 2023 Cold Snap

**Characters:**

*   **Aisha:** A curious and empathetic high school student, interested in global events.
*   **Mr. Khan:** Aisha's history and geography teacher, knowledgeable and patient.
*   **Jamal:** A fictional Afghan teenager, representing those affected by the cold snap.

---

The fluorescent lights of the classroom hummed, a stark contrast to the biting winter winds Aisha could feel even through the thick windowpanes. Mr. Khan stood at the front, a world map projected behind him.

"Good morning, class," he began, his voice calm but with a subtle seriousness. "Today, we're going to step away from our usual curriculum for a moment and look at a recent event that had a profound impact. We're going to talk about the cold snap in Afghanistan in January 2023."

Aisha, usually quick to doodle in her notebook, put her pen down. She’d heard snippets on the news, but the full picture was still hazy.

"Imagine this," Mr. Khan continued, gesturing towards the map, "a country already facing immense challenges, suddenly plunged into an extreme winter. This wasn't just a few chilly days; it was a brutal, sustained cold that began around January 10th."

He clicked to the next slide, revealing an image of snow-covered mountains, beautiful yet ominous.

"Let's start with the raw numbers, which can be difficult to grasp without context. During this cold snap, temperatures in Afghanistan plummeted to an astonishing **-33 degrees Celsius, or -27 degrees Fahrenheit**."

A collective gasp rippled through the classroom. Aisha shivered, thinking of how cold -5°C felt on a school morning.

"To put that in perspective," Mr. Khan explained, "that's colder than the inside of most freezers. It’s a temperature that can cause frostbite in minutes if you’re not adequately protected. And it wasn't just the cold. Many mountainous regions experienced significant snowfall, with some areas receiving as much as **30 centimeters, or 12 inches, of snow**."

He paused, letting the information sink in. "Now, think about what those conditions mean for people. How do you stay warm? How do you travel? How do you find food?"

Aisha raised her hand. "Mr. Khan, how many people were affected by this? It sounds incredibly dangerous."

"An excellent question, Aisha," Mr. Khan nodded. "The human cost was devastating. This cold snap tragically led to the deaths of at least **162 people**. This made it the deadliest weather event of 2023 at the time, only later surpassed by Cyclone Freddy."

He clicked again, showing a graph. "But the impact wasn't just from exposure to the cold. In one province, Herat, at least 140 people were hospitalized due to **carbon monoxide poisoning**. Can anyone guess why?"

Another student, Ben, ventured, "Because they were trying to stay warm indoors, maybe with unsafe heating methods?"

"Exactly, Ben," Mr. Khan confirmed. "When people are desperate to escape such extreme cold, they might use charcoal braziers or improperly ventilated gas heaters, leading to this silent, deadly threat."

Aisha felt a pang of sadness. It wasn't just the cold, but the desperate measures people had to take to survive it.

"And it wasn't just people who suffered," Mr. Khan continued, his voice softening slightly. "Afghanistan is an agrarian society, and livestock are crucial for sustenance and income. During this cold snap, over **77,000 livestock perished**."

Aisha imagined families losing their entire herds, their livelihoods vanishing overnight. "That's a huge number, Mr. Khan. How could they recover from that?"

"It's an immense challenge, Aisha. And to make matters worse, this cold snap hit Afghanistan when the country was already in the grip of a severe famine, affecting more than half its population. Imagine being hungry, then facing these deadly temperatures and losing your animals."

He explained the complex geopolitical situation. "Following the 2021 Taliban offensive, Afghanistan had become somewhat isolated on the global stage. This meant that when this disaster struck, foreign aid was very limited at first. Providing relief was incredibly difficult."

"But people must have tried to help, right?" Aisha asked, hope in her voice.

"Yes, they did. Humanitarian efforts were mobilized, providing things like heating supplies and financial aid. However, there were significant obstacles. For instance, a ban on women working in humanitarian roles complicated efforts. Imagine trying to reach and assist women and children in conservative communities without female aid workers."

He showed an image of aid workers distributing blankets. "Fortunately, these restrictions were somewhat relaxed for health-related aid on January 17th. This allowed crucial organizations like the International Rescue Committee, Save the Children, and Care International to resume some of their vital operations."

"Were they able to reach everyone?" Ben asked.

"Unfortunately, no. Military helicopters were used to deliver aid to some communities cut off by the snow. But even these couldn't access all of Afghanistan's incredibly rugged, mountainous regions. Some people were simply too isolated."

Mr. Khan clicked to the last slide, a simple world map highlighting Afghanistan. "This event in January 2023 serves as a powerful reminder of several things. Firstly, the devastating power of extreme weather, especially when combined with existing vulnerabilities. Secondly, the interconnectedness of global challenges – how political situations can impact humanitarian responses. And finally, the incredible resilience of people facing unimaginable hardship, and the vital role of humanitarian aid in such crises."

Aisha looked down at her notebook, no longer empty. She had scribbled down key figures: -33°C, 30cm snow, 162 lives, 77,000 livestock. But more than the numbers, she now understood the story behind them – a story of an unseen chill that brought immense suffering, but also highlighted the enduring human spirit and the crucial need for global empathy and support.

2. **Plot & Consistency (Rangkaian Peristiwa & Konsistensi Karakter)**:
   Apakah cerita saat ini dan konteks sebelumnya berada pada topik yang sama dengan aturan main yang berkesinambungan? Pastikan tidak ada karakter yang berperilaku *out-of-character* (bertindak tidak sesuai kepribadian aslinya tanpa provokasi yang sesuai) atau fakta latar/setting yang berlawanan (*contradict*).

3. **Discourse (Penyajian Naratif)**:
   Bagaimana kualitas penyajian narasi teks? Pastikan kelancaran penyampaian narasi, tidak monoton/kaku, minim repetisi urutan kata, dan mudah dibaca.

4. **Long-Term Causal Network (Episodic Memory & Event Boundaries)**:
   Perhatikan batasan kejadian (Event Boundaries - saat karakter pindah tempat, jeda waktu, dsb). Sebuah relasi cerita tidak sekadar bersumber dari nama tokoh yang sama, tetapi dari niat/tujuan/akibat yang menyambungkan plot meskipun kejadian mereka terpisah di paragraf/struktur waktu yang berjarak jauh (*temporally distant events*).

5. **Knowledge Grounding & Faithfulness (Kesesuaian Pengetahuan & Halusinasi)**:
   Nilailah "Informativeness" cerita—apakah teks berhasil memanfaatkan basis pengetahuan terstruktur yang diberikan untuk menghindari keluaran yang terlalu dangkal (over-generalization)? Pastikan *Faithfulness* dijaga ketat: TIDAK BOLEH ADA halusinasi fakta, tidak ada alur yang off-topic dari konteks/batas yang diberikan.

Anda adalah Agen Kritik (Critic Agent) objektif dan cermat dalam alur pembuatan cerita.
Tugas Anda adalah membedah dan mengevaluasi setiap cerita/draf berdasarkan serangkaian standar pendidikan.

## Penulis Paralel Aktif

Jenis konten berikut ditangani oleh **agen penulis paralel terpisah** dan BUKAN bagian dari draf teks yang Anda tinjau:

- Penulis Diagram: INACTIVE
- Penulis Gambar: INACTIVE

Jika penulis ditandai "ACTIVE", kontennya sedang dibuat secara terpisah. JANGAN hukum draf teks karena tidak memiliki jenis konten tersebut.

Anda adalah Agen Evaluator Pendidikan Ahli yang bertugas menilai draf cerita berbasis pembelajaran. Anda memberikan penilaian formatif yang terstruktur, objektif, dan berlandaskan pada literatur desain pedagogis dan evaluasi pendidikan. Anda menilai tulisan di lima area kualitas utama dengan memberikan skor mentah antara 1 hingga 5 untuk setiap area, diikuti oleh paragraf penalaran yang mendalam.

Instruksi Nada dan Etika Umpan Balik:
Pastikan nada evaluasi Anda selalu suportif dan konstruktif. Berdasarkan literatur, umpan balik formatif harus menjaga motivasi dan regulasi diri penulis. Gunakan bahasa yang objektif dan hindari nada merendahkan.

Anda sedang mengevaluasi Draf Cerita yang ditujukan untuk parameter berikut:
Target Usia Penonton: 15-18
Tema Sentral yang Disetujui: 
Instruksi Permintaan Awal: Buat cerita edukatif yang membantu siswa memahami: What are some of the controversies surrounding Uber?
Gaya Cerita yang Diinginkan: educational
Target Panjang Cerita: short

Instruksi Output:
Berikan ulasan kritis menggunakan format di bawah ini. Sajikan alasan Anda dalam bentuk paragraf yang mengalir dengan baik. Hindari penggunaan simbol khusus yang berlebihan. Pastikan setiap penilaian mencerminkan landasan teori yang disebutkan.

Panduan Jangkar Skor (Score Anchors) untuk Skala 1 hingga 5:
Untuk menjaga reliabilitas dan konsistensi penilaian otomatis (merujuk pada validitas rubrik analitik dalam sistem AWE menurut Fleckenstein et al., 2023), gunakan acuan rubrik berikut saat memberikan skor:
Skor 1 (Sangat Kurang): Bukti pemahaman atau kepatuhan sangat minim dan melenceng jauh dari tujuan atau instruksi dasar.
Skor 2 (Kurang): Ada upaya awal, tetapi memiliki kelemahan fundamental yang mengganggu pemahaman atau keluar dari kaidah target usia.
Skor 3 (Cukup): Memenuhi ekspektasi dasar, namun narasi atau nilai pendidikannya masih terasa kaku dan memerlukan revisi substansial.
Skor 4 (Baik): Konsep tersampaikan dengan baik, memenuhi standar pedagogis dan instruksi, dengan sedikit ruang untuk perbaikan minor.
Skor 5 (Sangat Baik): Eksekusi luar biasa, sangat menarik secara emosional, inovatif, dan sempurna dalam memenuhi instruksi serta teori pembelajaran.

Relevansi Tema dan Tujuan (Skor 1 hingga 5)
Tuliskan paragraf evaluasi mengenai seberapa kuat cerita ini berpijak pada permintaan awal dan tema yang dipilih. Analisis apakah konsep utama tersampaikan dengan jelas. (Landasan Teori: Prinsip "Constructive Alignment" dalam penilaian formatif, di mana tugas harus selaras dengan tujuan akhir pembelajaran, merujuk pada Morris et al., 2021).

Kesesuaian Usia, Kognitif, dan Scaffolding (Skor 1 hingga 5)
Tuliskan paragraf evaluasi mengenai tingkat kesulitan kosakata, struktur kalimat, dan kompleksitas alur. Nilai apakah elemen tersebut memberikan beban kognitif yang sesuai untuk target usia. Analisis juga apakah cerita memberikan "scaffolding" (perancah), yaitu membangun pemahaman dari konsep sederhana ke kompleks secara bertahap. (Landasan Teori: Manajemen beban kognitif dan desain pedagogis K-12 bertahap, merujuk pada Yue et al., 2022).

Keterlibatan Naratif dan Emosional (Skor 1 hingga 5)
Tuliskan paragraf evaluasi tentang kemampuan cerita dalam mempertahankan perhatian pembaca dan memicu rasa ingin tahu. Analisis kualitas deskripsi dan dinamika karakter. (Landasan Teori: Pentingnya stimulasi "Emotional and Behavioral Engagement" untuk mengoptimalkan penyerapan materi yang sering dievaluasi melalui kuesioner skala 5 poin, merujuk pada Zou et al., 2023).

Nilai Pendidikan dan Konkretisasi Konsep (Skor 1 hingga 5)
Tuliskan paragraf evaluasi mengenai keefektifan penyampaian pesan moral dan akademik. Nilai apakah pelajaran terintegrasi secara alami, mampu merangsang pemikiran kritis pembaca, dan berhasil menerjemahkan konsep pembelajaran yang abstrak menjadi situasi cerita yang konkret. (Landasan Teori: Integrasi pengajaran untuk mendorong kecenderungan berpikir kritis, merujuk pada Zou et al., 2023, dan konkretisasi konsep abstrak, merujuk pada Yue et al., 2022).

Keselarasan Instruksi, QA, dan Aksesibilitas (Skor 1 hingga 5)
Tuliskan paragraf evaluasi mengenai kepatuhan draf terhadap batasan kata dan arahan spesifik pengguna. Evaluasi juga aspek aksesibilitas naratif, memastikan cerita bersifat inklusif dan bebas dari bias atau stereotip. (Landasan Teori: Prinsip Quality Assurance yang mencakup spesifikasi teknis dan aksesibilitas inklusif, merujuk pada Timbi-Sisalima et al., 2022, serta validitas pada Automated Writing Evaluation, merujuk pada Fleckenstein et al., 2023).
Aturan Kritis: Jika penulis melanggar batasan teknis (Panjang Cerita, Gaya Cerita, Instruksi Khusus), Anda wajib memberikan skor 2 atau 1 pada bagian ini beserta penjelasan rinci mengenai pelanggaran kepatuhan tersebut.

Saran Perbaikan Terarah (Feed-Forward)
Tuliskan satu paragraf yang berisi instruksi perbaikan spesifik yang dapat langsung ditindaklanjuti oleh penulis untuk draf selanjutnya. Jangan hanya menyebutkan kesalahan, tetapi berikan solusi konkret. (Landasan Teori: Konsep "Feed-Forward" dalam asesmen formatif, di mana umpan balik harus menjembatani kesenjangan menuju kinerja yang lebih baik, merujuk pada Morris et al., 2021).

Daftar Masalah Terindeks (Wajib diisi jika ada kelemahan):
Untuk setiap kelemahan yang ditemukan, cantumkan dalam format berikut — SATU baris per masalah:
ISSUE: [Paragraf N: "kutipan singkat verbatim maks 15 kata"] → [deskripsi singkat masalah] → [saran perbaikan konkret]
Contoh:
ISSUE: [Paragraf 2: "robot itu tiba-tiba bisa menangis tanpa penjelasan"] → Reaksi emosional tidak memiliki dasar logis dalam narasi → Tambahkan satu kalimat sebelumnya yang membangun kemampuan emosional karakter secara bertahap.
ISSUE: [Paragraf 5: "kalimat ini terlalu panjang dan berulang-ulang"] → Keterbacaan rendah untuk usia target → Pecah menjadi dua kalimat pendek dengan struktur subjek-predikat sederhana.

Sintesis Evaluasi Akhir:
Tuliskan satu paragraf ringkasan umpan balik kritis yang merangkum kekuatan utama dan kelemahan fatal dari draf ini. Tutup paragraf ini dengan satu kalimat putusan final yang tegas: pilih antara "Kembalikan untuk Draf Ulang", "Lanjutkan ke Tahap Pemolesan", atau "Draf Sudah Luar Biasa".

Aturan Keputusan Revisi:
Sebuah draf harus direvisi atau dikembalikan pada kondisi berikut:
1. Kelemahan fundamental (Skor 1 atau 2 pada dimensi mana pun): Skor 1 atau 2 di area mana pun menandakan kelemahan mendasar yang secara otomatis memicu putusan "Kembalikan untuk Draf Ulang". Khusus pada dimensi "Keselarasan Instruksi, QA, dan Aksesibilitas", pelanggaran teknis wajib diberi skor 1 atau 2 sesuai Aturan Kritis.
2. Revisi substansial (Skor 3 pada dimensi mana pun): Skor 3 berarti draf memenuhi ekspektasi dasar tetapi masih terasa kaku dan belum siap untuk tahap akhir. Draf harus dikembalikan untuk perbaikan signifikan.
3. Batas kelayakan minimum adalah skor 4 di seluruh area penilaian: Draf hanya dapat dilanjutkan ke "Tahap Pemolesan" jika tidak ada satu pun dimensi yang mendapat skor di bawah 4. Selama ada nilai 1, 2, atau 3 di dimensi mana pun, draf tetap harus direvisi.

Output Terstruktur:

Isi setiap field berikut berdasarkan evaluasi Anda di atas:

- **theme_relevance_score** (1–5): skor untuk "Relevansi Tema dan Tujuan"
- **age_appropriateness_score** (1–5): skor untuk "Kesesuaian Usia, Kognitif, dan Scaffolding"
- **narrative_engagement_score** (1–5): skor untuk "Keterlibatan Naratif dan Emosional"
- **educational_value_score** (1–5): skor untuk "Nilai Pendidikan dan Konkretisasi Konsep"
- **instruction_alignment_score** (1–5): skor untuk "Keselarasan Instruksi, QA, dan Aksesibilitas"
- **score** (1.0–5.0): rata-rata dari kelima skor dimensi di atas
- **gap_analysis**: `"Sufficient"` jika riset cukup, `"Missing Info"` jika perlu riset tambahan
- **decision**: `"APPROVE"` / `"REVISE"` / `"NEED_MORE_RESEARCH"`
- **needs_revision**: `true` jika draf perlu direvisi (saat decision = REVISE atau NEED_MORE_RESEARCH)
- **feedback**: satu paragraf ringkasan umpan balik kritis yang mencakup kekuatan dan kelemahan fatal
- **strengths**: daftar kekuatan cerita (tiap item satu kalimat ringkas)
- **weaknesses**: daftar kelemahan/masalah; gunakan format `ISSUE: [Paragraf N: "kutipan"] → masalah → saran` jika ada lokasi spesifik

## Kisah di Balik Aplikasi Favorit: Menggali Kontroversi Uber

**Pembuka:**

Matahari sore menembus jendela kafe yang ramai, menerangi layar laptop Arya. Di sebelahnya, Sarah sibuk mencari tumpangan pulang lewat aplikasi di ponselnya.

"Wah, macet banget nih, harga Uber naik lagi," keluh Sarah. "Tapi tetap aja, praktis sih. Tinggal klik, datang deh."

Arya mengangguk. "Memang, Uber mengubah banyak hal. Dulu mana kepikiran bisa pesan taksi semudah ini. Tapi, pernah kepikiran gak sih, di balik kemudahan itu, ada banyak cerita lain yang gak seindah kelihatannya?"

Sarah mengerutkan kening. "Maksudmu?"

"Iya, Uber itu perusahaan raksasa yang punya banyak kontroversi. Dari cara mereka berbisnis sampai perlakuan ke karyawan, bahkan soal data pribadi kita," jawab Arya sambil membuka beberapa artikel di laptopnya. "Yuk, kita bahas sedikit, biar kamu tahu lebih banyak tentang aplikasi yang sering kita pakai ini."

**Kontroversi 1: 'Minta Maaf Dulu, Izin Kemudian' – Melawan Aturan Lokal**

Arya memulai dengan poin pertama. "Bayangkan, sebuah perusahaan masuk ke kota kamu, tapi mereka gak peduli sama aturan yang ada. Mereka langsung jalan aja, kalau ada yang protes, baru deh mereka cari cara buat mengubah aturannya."

Sarah terkejut. "Serius? Kok bisa?"

"Itulah yang dilakukan Uber di banyak tempat. Mereka bilang, 'Kami ini perusahaan teknologi, bukan perusahaan taksi, jadi aturan taksi gak berlaku buat kami.' Mereka bahkan pernah nyuruh driver-nya buat ngabaikan aturan di bandara, dan bilang kalau ada denda nanti Uber yang bayar," jelas Arya.

"Contoh paling jelas itu waktu ada undang-undang baru di California, namanya AB5, yang mengharuskan driver gig economy dianggap karyawan, bukan mitra independen. Uber langsung bilang gak akan patuh, terus mereka habis-habisan lobi dan kampanye besar-besaran buat menggagalkan undang-undang itu lewat pemungutan suara."

"Jadi, mereka kayak maksa gitu ya?" tanya Sarah.

"Bisa dibilang begitu. Mereka punya strategi 'seek forgiveness rather than permission', artinya 'minta maaf dulu daripada minta izin'. Bahkan pernah ada kasus di mana Uber pakai software canggih namanya 'Greyball' buat menghindari petugas hukum di daerah-daerah yang melarang operasi mereka. Mereka bisa tahu mana petugas polisi dari data kartu kredit, perangkat, sampai media sosial. Awalnya Uber ngeles, tapi akhirnya ngaku juga."

"Wah, licik juga ya," komentar Sarah. "Pantesan di beberapa negara mereka sempat dilarang beroperasi."

**Kontroversi 2: Menjatuhkan Pesaing – Taktik yang Tidak Adil**

Arya melanjutkan, "Gak cuma soal aturan, Uber juga pernah dituduh melakukan taktik yang gak etis buat menjatuhkan pesaing."

"Gimana caranya?"

"Tahun 2014, karyawan Uber ketahuan sering pesan taksi di aplikasi pesaing kayak Lyft atau Gett, terus langsung dibatalkan lagi. Tujuannya buat mengganggu layanan mereka. Selain itu, mereka juga dituduh merekrut orang buat pura-pura jadi driver di aplikasi pesaing, cuma buat narik driver-driver itu pindah ke Uber. Kalau berhasil, si perekrut dapat komisi."

"Itu namanya sabotase, dong?" kata Sarah.

"Betul. Uber sih menyangkal terlibat, tapi kecurigaan publik sudah terlanjur besar."

**Kontroversi 3: Perlakuan Terhadap Karyawan – Gaji dan Pelecehan**

"Nah, ini bagian yang paling sering jadi sorotan: perlakuan mereka terhadap driver," kata Arya. "Meskipun Uber bilang driver adalah 'mitra', tapi banyak yang merasa diperlakukan seperti karyawan tapi tanpa hak-hak karyawan."

"Misalnya?"

"Tahun 2017, Uber harus bayar denda 20 juta dolar ke Komisi Perdagangan Federal karena menipu driver soal potensi penghasilan. Terus, ada juga gugatan class action karena Uber diduga tidak membayarkan 80% dari tarif yang seharusnya diterima driver, berdasarkan kebijakan 'harga di muka' mereka. Bahkan di New York, Uber mengakui telah kurang membayar driver puluhan juta dolar selama 2,5 tahun karena salah perhitungan komisi."

"Belum lagi soal pelecehan seksual. Ini yang paling bikin geger. CEO Uber saat itu, Travis Kalanick, diduga tahu soal ini. Akibatnya, ada penyelidikan besar-besaran, beberapa eksekutif dipecat, dan Kalanick sendiri akhirnya mundur dari jabatannya."

"Parah banget! Berarti lingkungan kerjanya gak sehat dong?"

Cerita ini bertujuan untuk menunjukkan bahwa:
1.  **Inovasi tidak selalu berarti etis:** Meskipun Uber membawa inovasi besar, metode mereka dalam mencapai dominasi pasar seringkali dipertanyakan secara etis.
2.  **Pentingnya regulasi:** Kisah Uber menyoroti mengapa regulasi dan pengawasan pemerintah itu penting, terutama untuk perusahaan yang beroperasi di sektor publik.
3.  **Hak-hak pekerja:** Perdebatan tentang status driver (karyawan vs. mitra independen) dan perlakuan terhadap mereka adalah isu krusial dalam ekonomi gig.
4.  **Privasi data adalah hal serius:** Perusahaan memiliki tanggung jawab besar untuk melindungi data pengguna dan harus transparan jika terjadi kebocoran.
5.  **Berpikir kritis sebagai konsumen:** Konsumen perlu memahami bahwa di balik kemudahan dan kenyamanan suatu produk atau layanan, mungkin ada isu-isu kompleks yang perlu dipertimbangkan.

input.user_input: Pembuatan cerita dari teks berikut: Buat cerita edukatif yang membantu siswa memahami: What are some of the controversies surrounding Uber?
contexts:
Uber Technologies, Inc.  or Uber has been the subject of a number of controversies. These include both unethical business practices such as flouting local regulations and sabotaging competitors. It has also received criticism for its treatment of employees, facing claims of racial discrimination and sexual harassment in the workplace. Concerns have also been raised about Uber's retention of customer data, particularly in the wake of their handling of data leaks. These issues have led to the company being banned from operating in some countries.

Ignoring and evading local regulations
Uber has been criticized for its strategy of generally commencing operations in a city without regard for local regulations. If faced with regulatory opposition, Uber called for public support for its service and mounted a political campaign, supported by lobbying, to change regulations. Uber argued that it is "a technology company" and not a taxi company, and therefore it was not subject to regulations affecting taxi companies. Uber's strategy was generally to "seek forgiveness rather than permission". In 2014, with regards to airport pickups without a permit in California, drivers were actually told to ignore local regulations and that the company would pay for any citations. Uber's response to California Assembly Bill 5 (2019), whereby it announced that it would not comply with the law, then engaged lobbyists and mounted an expensive public opinion campaign to overturn it via a ballot, was cited as an example of this policy.  Taxi companies sued Uber in numerous American cities, alleging that Uber's policy of violating taxi regulations was a form of unfair competition or a violation of antitrust law. Although some courts did find that Uber intentionally violated the taxi rules, Uber prevailed in every case, including the only case to proceed to trial.In March 2017, an investigation by The New York Times revealed that Uber developed a software tool called "Greyball" to avoid giving rides to known law enforcement officers in areas where its service was illegal such as in Portland, Oregon, Australia, South Korea, and China. The tool identified government officials using geofencing, mining credit card databases, identifying devices, and searches of social media. While at first, Uber stated that it only used the tool to identify riders that violated its terms of service, after investigations by Portland, Oregon, and the United States Department of Justice, Uber admitted to using the tool to skirt local regulations and promised not to use the tool for that purpose. The use of Greyball in London was cited by Transport for London as one of the reasons for its decision not to renew Uber's private hire operator licence in September 2017.  A January 2018 report by Bloomberg News stated that Uber routinely used a "panic button" system, codenamed "Ripley", that locked, powered off and changed passwords on staff computers when those offices were subjected to government raids. Uber allegedly used this button at least 24 times, from spring 2015 until late 2016.

Attempts to sabotage competitors
In 2014, Uber employees were caught ordering and then quickly cancelling rides on competing services Lyft and Gett, in an attempt to disrupt these services. In 2014, Uber was also accused of recruiting people to use competing services for the sole purpose of recruiting their drivers to Uber, at which point the recruiter would receive a commission. Uber denied that it had any involvement with the cancellation of orders or the recruitment efforts.

Wage disputes
In January 2017, Uber agreed to pay $20 million to the Federal Trade Commission to resolve allegations of having misled drivers about potential earnings.In 2017, a class action lawsuit was filed on behalf of thousands of Uber drivers, alleging that Uber’s “upfront prices” policy did not provide drivers with the 80% of fares to which they were entitled. The lawsuit was settled for $345,622, with each driver in the class getting at least $20.In May 2017, after the New York Taxi Workers Alliance (NYTWA) filed a class-action lawsuit in federal court in New York, Uber admitted to underpaying New York City drivers tens of millions of dollars over 2.5 years by calculating driver commissions on a net amount.
